ideas.idea: Back up the vague 'integrates with all the tools' claim by naming integrations, ideally on /features
ideas.why: The home page makes an unsupported claim and features.tsx names no integrations, so specifics give readers and machines something concrete to quote.

ideas.idea: Add plan names, prices and contents to /pricing, plus a contact route
ideas.why: pricing.tsx has only a vague 'talk to us' line, so concrete plan details would answer what visitors come to learn.

ideas.idea: Expand the thin /features page with a section per feature
ideas.why: features.tsx has a single line of text, so more detail would help people and machines understand the product.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD using the name and URL from geo.config.json
ideas.why: The brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, so this pushes something that was ruled out.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> dates to sitemap.xml, especially for the changelog
ideas.why: It's accurate because the sitemap has no lastmod, but it has little effect on discovery and applies to almost any sitemap.

ideas.idea: Give each changelog release its own URL
ideas.why: changelog.tsx renders one list, so separate addresses would let individual releases be linked and cited.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport to root meta, plus og:title and og:description social tags
ideas.why: This is accurate because root.tsx lacks them, but it is boilerplate advice for any site and does little for finding or understanding the content.

ideas.idea: Drop the root default description once every route has its own
ideas.why: The root description is only a fallback and its overlap with the h1 is trivial, so removing it has almost no effect.

ideas.idea: Add /features to the nav in root.tsx
ideas.why: The nav in root.tsx links only Pricing and Changelog, so a real nav link would make /features reachable from every page.

ideas.idea: Use a Remix loader for changelog entries
ideas.why: This is the specific fix for the useEffect fetch, though it overlaps the known problem.
